For example, while the Router marked atom 3 as false, I independently verified the spatial relationship by examining the image and confirming the dogs are beside/behind the horse, not over it. I also independently confirmed the car is an SUV (not convertible) based on roof structure, rather than accepting the Router's description at face value.

5. Harshness Bias: I avoided over-penalizing minor issues. The text hallucination ('GIAN') and slight headlight warp are noted as defects but did not disproportionately lower the authenticity score beyond what the major texture and structural issues already warranted. The glitter texture, while a severe deviation from biological reality, was scored consistently across all affected atoms rather than compounding penalties.
